agents_view_permission.name: agents_view_permission
agents_view_permission.using:
organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer
      AND (
        owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid
        OR user_has_permission(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
          'agents:view',
          organization_id,
          'agent',
          id
        )
      )

rag_query_logs_manage_permission.name: rag_query_logs_manage_permission
rag_query_logs_manage_permission.using:
(organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer OR (organization_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag_indexes ri WHERE ri.id = rag_index_id AND ri.organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer)))
      AND user_has_permission(
        current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
        'data:manage',
        COALESCE(organization_id, (SELECT ri.organization_id FROM rag_indexes ri WHERE ri.id = rag_index_id))
      )

rag_query_logs_view_permission.name: rag_query_logs_view_permission
rag_query_logs_view_permission.using:
(user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid OR user_has_permission(
        current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
        'data:view',
        COALESCE(organization_id, (SELECT ri.organization_id FROM rag_indexes ri WHERE ri.id = rag_index_id))
      ))
      AND (organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer OR (organization_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rag_indexes ri WHERE ri.id = rag_index_id AND ri.organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer)))

skills_view_permission.name: skills_view_permission
skills_view_permission.using:
organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer
      AND (
        (agent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM agents a
          WHERE a.id = agent_id
          AND (
            a.owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid
            OR user_has_permission(
              current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
              'agents:view',
              a.organization_id,
              'agent',
              a.id
            )
          )
        ))
        OR
        (agent_id IS NULL AND user_has_permission(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
          'skills:view',
          organization_id,
          'organization',
          organization_id
        ))
      )
